nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a self-adjoint bounded linear operator on a nonzero Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. Then $\operatorname{Re}\langle Tu, u\rangle \ge 0$ for every $u \in H$ if and only if every element $\mu$ of the spectrum of $T$ satisfies $\operatorname{Re}\mu \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Positivity iff spectrum nonnegative

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on an inner product space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $I$ be the identity operator on $H$, and write $R_S(x) = \operatorname{Re}\langle Sx, x\rangle / \|x\|^2$ for the Rayleigh quotient of an operator $S$. Then for every real number $t$ and every nonzero $x \in H$, $R_{tI - T}(x) = t - R_T(x)$.
nodes.title: Rayleigh quotient of a shifted operator

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a self-adjoint bounded linear operator on a nonzero Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, with Rayleigh quotient $R_T(x) = \operatorname{Re}\langle Tx, x\rangle / \|x\|^2$. Then every $\mu$ in the spectrum of $T$ satisfies $\inf_{x \ne 0} R_T(x) \le \operatorname{Re}\mu \le \sup_{x \ne 0} R_T(x)$, where the infimum and supremum range over the nonzero vectors $x \in H$.
nodes.title: Spectrum bounds over nonzero vectors

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a self-adjoint bounded linear operator on a nonzero Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, with Rayleigh quotient $R_T(x) = \operatorname{Re}\langle Tx, x\rangle / \|x\|^2$ for $x \ne 0$ and $R_T(0) = 0$. Then every $\mu$ in the spectrum of $T$ satisfies $\inf_{x \in H} R_T(x) \le \operatorname{Re}\mu \le \sup_{x \in H} R_T(x)$.
nodes.title: Spectrum bounds over all vectors

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on a Hilbert space $H$ over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. If $\operatorname{Re}\langle Tu, u\rangle \ge 0$ for every $u \in H$, then every element $\mu$ of the spectrum of $T$ satisfies $\operatorname{Re}\mu \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Spectrum of an accretive operator has nonnegative real part

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
